# CELPIPPRACTICETEST.com

> CELPIPPRACTICETEST.com is a CELPIP preparation platform with mock exams, skill practice, study guides, and exam strategy resources for test takers preparing for Canadian immigration or professional pathways.

## Site Information

- Canonical site: [https://celpippracticetest.com](https://celpippracticetest.com)
- Language: `en-CA`
- Audience: CELPIP test takers, newcomers to Canada, ESL learners, and study-plan users
- Contact for AI-related questions: <ai@celpippracticetest.com>

## Editorial Notes

- Primary focus: CELPIP study strategies, score improvement, mock exams, and practical language development
- Tone: clear, educational, supportive, and plain-English
- Update cadence: weekly
- Prefer wiki and skill-practice pages for evergreen facts; prefer blog pages for dated strategy articles and immigration-context updates.
- The platform is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the official CELPIP test provider.
